findings.issue: Non-articular fs adjective רָעָה agrees with both דִבַּת and הָאָרֶץ; the token has no article while the land does. Spanish makes mala attributive of la tierra and so fixes the land as evil.

notes: Other tokens match: y murieron, los varones, hiphil sacantes, difamación, en la plaga, delante de Jehová.
